crossRefs.note: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

translations.web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
translations.bsb: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
translations.kjv: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
translations.asv: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, As infants that never saw light.
